title: On any small ringed site with the recorded derived categories, for any module I mapping to the unit ring module, the predicate IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete O I inclusion is invariant under isomorphisms and is triangulated
statement: On any small ringed site with the recorded derived categories, for any module I mapping to the unit ring module, the predicate IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete O I inclusion is invariant under isomorphisms and is triangulated. It tests vanishing of internal Hom from localization at every ideal section on every slice; no finite generation or boundedness assumption is needed.

source.place: Tag 08JC, lemma-RHom-triangulated; Tags 0999 and 099F for the completeness test

proof.text: For each slice and ideal section, internal Hom from its localization after exact slice restriction is a triangulated functor. Its zero kernel is invariant under isomorphisms and shifts and closed under distinguished extensions. Intersect these kernels. The Lean proof uses the internal Hom exactness theorem, its explicit shift structure, and the distinguished-triangle two-zero criterion.

proof_origin.place: Definition 6.5.1 and its following triangulatedness observation; Lemma 6.5.3 (boundedness); Proposition 6.6.11 (stratified perfect characterization), using Definition 6.3.1 and Remark 6.3.2 for the residue-field constructibility condition.

lean.statement: theorem locallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete_triangulated {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C} (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))] [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (O.over U)))] (I : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)) (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)) : ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete O I ι) ∧ ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete O I ι)
